inference_basis: Under the installed adaptive schedule, reaching 1e-5 from 1e-3 requires at least 12 decay events, each conditioned on minibatch mean KL > 0.02.
limitation: Per-minibatch KL was not logged; this is a lower bound inferred from code and the recorded final learning rate.
behavior: The scheduler changes the learning rate for the next optimizer step. It does not roll back an earlier update or impose a hard action-change bound.
